name: Osun-Osogbo Sacred Grove
description: Just outside the city of Osogbo in southwestern Nigeria, this patch of dense forest follows the winding Osun River and is one of the last remnants of old high forest in the south. It is home to Osun, the Yoruba goddess of fertility, and is scattered with shrines, sculptures and sanctuaries. Once, nearly every Yoruba town had a grove like this; today it is probably the last.
